Synthetic local TLS fixtures only. The deliberately public P-256 test private scalars are 42 (CA) and 43 (server); these are not secrets and must never be used outside tests. Validity is 2020-01-01 through 2040-01-01. The server SAN contains literal loopback IPs only. Clients must explicitly trust ca.pem; default trust rejects it. Certificates were generated offline with Python cryptography. No production identity or service was contacted.
